title: AtMem capabilities v1

governed_task_session_binding.description: The runtime implements operator-registered session-to-task binding. Whether a given host can use it is per-adapter; read governed_task_session_binding_adapters.

governed_task_host_proposal.description: The runtime accepts host-boundary task proposals. Per-adapter availability is in governed_task_host_proposal_adapters.

governed_task_agent_delta_tool.description: The runtime supports a model-facing typed-delta tool. An adapter that does not register one must not be listed in governed_task_agent_delta_tool_adapters.

governed_task_session_binding_adapters.description: Adapters that supply a session generation rotating on conversation reset. An adapter that cannot must report session binding unavailable rather than binding under a lifetime alone.

governed_task_host_proposal_adapters.description: Adapters that can submit authenticated session-bound task requests.

governed_task_agent_delta_tool_adapters.description: Adapters that register the typed-delta tool with their model. An unregistered tool is invisible to the model and is never claimed here.

description: The single authoritative runtime capability response. Adapter replies, documentation, and tests mirror this; none of them is an independent capability authority.
